_about: Every photo the site needs. 'folder' is the drop folder under photos/. 'key' links to the slot on an image in src/content. 'max' is how many photos are used (0 means any number). 'decor' slots become room art in public/assets/decor/. Optional: 'file' (one named file under photos/), 'pdfPages' (render those PDF pages), 'video' (compress the MP4 in the folder), 'alts' (alt text by file name), 'text' (higher quality for slides and screenshots). 'aspect' (width / height) centre crops a folder's images to one shape. 'splitRows' cuts listed collages (two photos stacked) into two photos.
